meaning:
προσ-οχθίζω
[in LXX: Lev.26:15, al. (גָּעַל); Lev.18:25, al. (קוֹא), Psa.95:10, Eze.36:31 (קוּט), Sir.6:25, al. (other writers use ὀχθέω, rarely -ίζω) ;]
to be angry with: with dative, Heb.3:10 (LXX), Heb.3:17.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’
